DIAGNOSIS: Facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) - autosomal dominant, likely sporadic given negative family history, caused by D4Z4 repeat contraction on chromosome 4

Alternatives:
1. Congenital myopathy (e.g., nemaline myopathy or centronuclear myopathy)
2. Spinal muscular atrophy, scapuloperoneal distribution
3. Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy
